rule: Background is the most common colour and the frame is the most frequent other colour. The output is the bounding box of the frame colour. Background cells inside it are holes. These holes are tiled exactly by the multicoloured 4-connected pieces lying outside the box. Pieces are not rotated and each is used once. A compound hole may take several pieces.
scope: Construct rectangular-piece tilings of an edge frame, including compound holes, multicolour pieces, duplicate pieces and all four frame sides.
constraints: Read construction and exhaustive ambiguity rejection against archived tiling rule and canonical fixtures.

known_limitations: Frames occupy an entire grid side, pieces are rectangles, and rotations are not allowed.
Same-shaped pieces share one colouring in random scenes; no unused distractors.
Random piece sides are at most six and area at most 24; larger fixture pieces use explicit replay.
Uniqueness search has a node budget and rejects inconclusive scenes; bounded placement may reject tight controls.

authored_scope: Random scenes sample: frame side (left/right/top/bottom); frame depth (5-10 by default, 4-16 if overridden); grid size (up to 30 per side); background and frame colours; rectangular holes that are isolated or touching; piece colourings (solid, checker, bordered checker, end-cap, stagger). Same-shape pieces share a colouring, giving duplicates as in the fixtures. Sizes other than the fixture sizes are synthetic extensions. Not supported: frames that do not span a full grid side, non-rectangular pieces, distractor pieces that are left unused, and frame regions placed away from the grid edge.
authored_constraints: Frame region spans one full side of the grid. Its inner edge line and its two outer corners are never holes, so the frame-colour bounding box equals the region.
A full background line separates the frame region from the piece area.
Pieces lie only in the piece area. They are 8-separated from each other, so each piece is exactly one 4-connected component.
Piece colours exclude background and frame colours.
Background count is strictly greater than frame count. Frame count is strictly greater than every other colour count.
Exhaustive bounded search: every exact tiling yields the same output colouring. Scenes that exceed the search budget are rejected.
Total piece area equals total hole area, with at least 3 pieces.

Incompatible overrides raise ValueError: frame==background, colours out of 0..9, size out of 1..30, unknown side, extent<4, or too small a piece area. Explicit-pieces mode requires all scene arguments.
